variants.hook: Tennis.

variants.title: Poke47 (More with Followers)
variants.hook: Emerald repopulated with only Gen 4–7 Pokémon, all rebalanced, plus hand-coded moves, abilities and items, followers that roam and autobattle, and Gauntlet Island, a roguelite mode open from the start. Vanilla+ with an optional level cap.

variants.title: Pokemon Advanced Adventure (2018 Final)
variants.hook: LeafGreen hack where you play Ash or Misty in a new region, stopping Oak's grandson and his eight genetically modified 'tyrant' Pokémon. Only Surf and Fly as HMs, no trade evolutions, a few Gen 5 mons, a gods-themed postgame. Dated 2010s binary hack.

variants.title: Pokemon Aesthetic Red
variants.hook: FireRed with a full DS/Game Boy-inspired graphics and music overhaul, open-world Kanto and Sevii (no HM locks, gyms in any order), Gen 1–2 dex, reusable TMs, optional level caps, scaling and randomizers, and harder rebalanced bosses. Nonlinear and polished.

variants.title: Pokemon Aether White 2
variants.hook: Nuzlocke-focused White 2 difficulty hack: 800+ reworked trainer battles, 500 obtainable Pokemon with custom learnsets and rebalanced stats/abilities, extra grass for encounters, custom Hidden Grottos, scripted Champion fights, infinite Rare Candies.

variants.title: Pokemon All In Version
variants.hook: Emerald rebuilt around gambling: Pokémon come only from Game Corner gacha machines, marts are replaced by casinos, plus loan sharks and a black market, and toggles for D20, coin-flip and slot-machine battle effects, no-EXP and nuzlocke modes. Chaotic and systemic.

variants.title: Pokemon Amethyst
variants.hook: CFRU FireRed hack set in the new Kulure region: curated Gen 1–8 dex, gyms themed by battle concepts (terrain, status) instead of types, PokeChips currency from wild battles, Casual/Standard/Hard modes, Sinnoh-style mining, unlockable game modifiers. Solo dev's first hack; fully playable.

variants.title: Pokemon Ash Gray (Newerest Edition)
variants.hook: Bug-fix patch of metapod23's Ash Gray beta 4.5.3, the FireRed hack that retells Ash's anime journey episode by episode. Fixes crashes, soft-locks and the Bad Egg save corruption (PC boxes 2, 3 and 6 are locked). Story is still the unfinished 4.5.3 beta.

variants.title: Pokemon - Black Version (NDSi Enhanced)
variants.hook: Gen 5 Pokemon; all-new roster, standard loop.

variants.title: Pokemon Blaze Black 2 (Complete)
variants.hook: Drayano's Black 2 overhaul: all 649 Pokemon catchable in-game, every trainer roster rebuilt for a much harder curve, plus Pokemon/move/learnset buffs. 'Complete' is the patch with those edits; superseded by the Redux remake.

variants.title: Pokemon Blazing Emerald
variants.hook: Struedelmuffin's restyled Emerald: Clefairy, Eevee or Pikachu starters (28 options), Hoennian regional forms and fakemon, smarter AI and boss teams, Hard Mode with per-badge level caps, a new Eclipse weather, reusable TMs and EV/IV tools. v1.6 adds Bede to the Elite Four.

variants.title: Pokemon Clover
variants.hook: /vp/'s FireRed hack with 386 original 'Clovermon', the Fochun region plus post-league Ebin Isles, soft level caps, smarter AI and NewGame+. Imageboard humour everywhere. v1.3.3 is the final 1.x hotfix; Battle Channel unfinished, saves won't carry into 2.0.

variants.title: Pokemon Colors
variants.hook: LeafGreen hack that retypes every Pokémon to match its sprite colours, reworking movepools, abilities, stats, encounters and every trainer team (now with Gen 2–3 mons), plus physical/special split and a stat-neutral Classic mode. Tougher bosses; full docs and a damage calc.

variants.title: Pokemon Colosseum
variants.hook: Double-battle Pokemon with snagging; darker tone.

variants.title: Pokemon Conquest (NDSi Enhanced)
variants.hook: Nobunaga's Ambition crossover: conquer 17 kingdoms with warlord-Pokemon pairs in grid tactics. Light but real strategy.

variants.title: Pokemon Crestfall
variants.hook: Emerald-expansion hack set in the new Enpale region: you're the reigning champion's child facing Team Covenant, with a 300-mon dex drawn from every generation, Megas, mining, infinite berries, Pokémon-less HMs and a rock/metal soundtrack. Early 1.1.x build.

variants.title: Pokemon Crystal Advance Redux
variants.hook: arnie's binary-hacked Crystal remake on FireRed: nine selectable protagonists (incl. Ash), day/night plus seasons, a 553-entry dex with Gen 3–4 and regional forms, Fairy type, faster battle pacing, toggleable Exp All. Playable through Red; regularly rebuilt.

variants.title: Pokemon Dark Rising
variants.hook: DarkRisingGirl's 2012 original: an Arceus dream opens a Core-region quest against Darugis, with Gen 4–5 Pokémon but no physical/special split, overleveled boss fights and forced grinding. Edgy, unbalanced.

variants.title: Pokemon Dark Rising 2 (Final)
variants.hook: DarkRisingGirl's sequel set in the Omni region: start with a fully evolved Dragonite, Salamence or Garchomp, now with the physical/special split, hidden abilities and Megas, against bosses packing absurdly overpowered legendaries. Edgy, grindy, downer twist ending.

variants.title: Pokemon Dark Rising Origins
variants.hook: Almost certainly Dark Rising Origins: Worlds Collide, a non-canon Digimon crossover: catch 193 Pokémon and 193 Digimon in the Ferrum region and battle the Seven Great Demon Lords, with Megas, Fairy type and an HGSS soundtrack. Not a prequel.

variants.title: Pokemon Dark Violet (2022 Update)
variants.hook: Chaos Rush's from-scratch Gen 1 reboot, finished by hacksrepairman: Red, Green and Blue travel together, Giovanni's son Kamon is your rival, 210-mon Kanto dex, DS-style sprites, Gen 4–5 moves with physical/special split, new gym order. Writing is admittedly edgy.

variants.title: Pokémon Dreams
variants.hook: MonopolyRubix's FireRed hack with a new region and character-focused story: Gens 1-7 plus 35 Fakemon, Gen 7 movesets and mechanics, and optional areas that reward exploration off a linear plot. Difficulty sits near the main series, with optional level-scaling, doubles and inverse modes.

variants.title: Pokemon Dreamstone Mysteries
variants.hook: dsmyst's Emerald-expansion hack in the new Cormoria region: track a missing professor and the Dreamstones against Team Somber. ~300 curated mons, early EXP Share, mints and EV editor, followers, no HMs, a quest tracker, Megas, fishing and mining minigames.

variants.title: Pokemon Elysium (Part A)
variants.hook: First half of BlackKaiser's story-led FireRed hack: a 16-year-old from Crysta island chasing a tournament on Elysium as an ancient threat stirs. Gen 1–6 mix, Fairy, PSS, permanent Megas, quest log, side quests. Part A ends on the S.S. Challenger; continue in Part B.

variants.title: Pokemon Emerald Blitz
variants.hook: Emerald cut down for 90-minute nuzlocke draft races: plot removed, gyms randomized with scaled leaders, Frontier Brains join an 'Elite Eight', hard level caps, no battle items, stat boosts capped at +1, Level Cap Candy and a Flygon 'bike'. Tight solo roguelite runs too.

variants.title: Pokemon Emerald Rogue (v2.2.1-EX)
variants.hook: Pokemon as a roguelike: from a hub you head out on randomized route-and-encounter runs against randomly generated gyms, E4 and champion, then spend progress upgrading Pokémon, items and the hub. EX build has Gens 1-9 and modern mechanics.

variants.title: Pokemon Emerald Seaglass
variants.hook: Nemo622's Emerald redrawn in a Gold/Silver-style look: all Gen 1–3 Pokémon plus cross-gen evolutions, retyped underdogs, PSS and Fairy, followers, DexNav, party EXP share with soft caps, optional Hard Mode, Pinball and Scuba Safari. v3.0 adds Brendan/May sprites.

variants.title: Pokemon - Emerald Version
variants.hook: Gen 3 definitive; Battle Frontier.

variants.title: Pokemon Exceeded
variants.hook: Alt-timeline Emerald where Team Rocket won Kanto: every Pokémon can carry up to four abilities, 150+ new abilities and 50+ new moves, Gen 1–9 dex with Z-A Megas, Legends-style stat formulas, four difficulties plus nuzlocke, randomizer and sandbox options, Frontier postgame.

variants.title: Pokemon Fire of Sky
variants.hook: Teon's short (~4 h) Emerald-expansion tale set before Poké Balls: a villager and a partner Pokémon investigate why Pokémon turned hostile near a Ho-Oh-worshipping mountain village. No trainer battles, only wild fights and bosses; passive HP regen, scroll TMs, new forms.

variants.title: Pokemon FireRed Rocket Edition
variants.hook: Play a Team Rocket recruit in a story running parallel to FireRed: steal a Pokémon from every trainer you beat (more classes as you rank up), take morality-driven side jobs, with Fairy type, PSS and Gen 4–6 moves. v1.0.2 is the finished release. The cleverest FireRed reskin.

variants.title: Pokemon - FireRed Version
variants.hook: Kanto remake.

variants.title: Pokemon Fluvio
variants.hook: Beta set in Viridis, a Netherlands-inspired region of polders and canals, against the flood-plotting Levellers: quest log, animated followers, day/night lighting, campsite camper shops, Gen 9 engine with level caps. Covers about four gyms (~10 h); expect bugs.

variants.title: Pokemon Forbidden Memories
variants.hook: Emerald turned into Yu-Gi-Oh! Forbidden Memories: the PS1 game's story, map and cast retold with 202 cards that battle like monsters. v0.9.5.2 reworks the Final 7, adds shiny cards and post-duel card rewards. Pre-1.0 novelty crossover.

variants.title: Pokemon Gaia
variants.hook: FireRed hack set in the ruin-strewn Orbtus region: Gen 1-6 Pokémon, ORAS-accurate moves, Megas, Fairy type, Dive and Rock Climb, hidden grottoes and a Battle Maison-style facility. v3.2 runs through the League; no postgame yet. A polished classic.

variants.title: Pokemon Garbage Gold Deluxe
variants.hook: hg-engine 'trashlocke' HeartGold: only sub-425 BST Pokemon (Gen 1-9), late or no evolutions, custom battle AI, no-heal gauntlets, BW2-tiled Kanto Wasteland and a post-war Johto story. Rare Candies, level caps, nuzlocke-ready.

variants.title: Pokemon Ghost Grey Version
variants.hook: Complete FireRed horror hack set in a decayed Kanto, 2049: an all-Ghost dex of 200+ (120+ original regional forms), all-original art and 130-song score, 7 badges plus postgame. Generous QoL: infinite Rare Candy, reusable TMs, no IVs/EVs or breeding. Fresh, and respects your time.

variants.title: Pokemon Glazed
variants.hook: Classic Emerald epic spanning Tunod, Johto and Rankor, with five starters, a real-world/Pokémon-world plot and 400+ Pokémon. TrainerX493's 9.2.0 update adds gen-9 learnsets, modern status rules, stronger AI from Johto and faster battles; old dex/cry glitches remain. Long, old-school.

variants.title: Pokemon Golden Shield
variants.hook: HeartGold rebuilt on hg-engine around the Galar dex: Gen 8 wilds, gifts and trades, every trainer on Galar Pokemon, moves and abilities up to Gen 9, reusable TMs, only Surf and Fly required. Story kept intact; a vanilla+ difficulty.

variants.title: Pokemon GS Chronicles
variants.hook: FireRed soft reboot of Gold/Silver on CFRU: new story beats and a friendly rival, HGSS-style maps and music, 500+ Pokémon, Megas, PokéRides replacing HMs, smarter trainer AI. Build 2.7.6 is a beta: 8 badges and the League, Kanto not yet in. Solid but unfinished.

variants.title: Pokemon Heart and Soul
variants.hook: Complete open-source Johto remake on modern Emerald decomp: full GSC/HGSS story plus Kanto postgame, Gen 1-3 dex, following Pokémon, toggleable split/Fairy/autorun, optional level caps, nuzlocke and randomizer modes. 2.0 rebuild added Gen 9 abilities and PokéGear. Best GBA Johto, but familiar.

variants.title: Pokemon - HeartGold Version
variants.hook: Gen 2 remake; the fan favourite.

variants.title: Pokemon Hearth
variants.hook: Cozy Emerald-decomp demo set in Toku, a region loosely inspired by pre-modern Japan and China: new story and custom graphics, quests, campfires, NPC schedules and a traveling merchant, vanilla-ish difficulty. v0.1.27 stops at the third gym. Short demo, mostly vibes.

variants.title: Pokemon Hodgepodge Platoon
variants.hook: Pebbler Platoon's Fakemon hack: 170+ usable creatures from 30+ artists, caught across two abandoned regions or drafted in a refined Battle Factory rental gauntlet with reworked types, statuses, moves and AI. Short, methodical and replayable.

variants.title: Pokemon Inkwell
variants.hook: Story-driven mystery roguelike on Emerald by Unfolding and DizzyEgg: randomized floors, enemies, items and upgrades, unlockable characters with team synergies, permanent and per-run progression, and an overhauled scaling system. Complete, 4-8 hours. Start here.

variants.title: Pokemon Johto Adventures Rebirth (Alpha 2.1)
variants.hook: FireRed anime adaptation: play as Ash through the Johto saga episode by episode, traveling with Brock and Misty and catching Ash's Pokémon. Alpha 2.1 covers only a short run of early Johto episodes, and the creator later declared the hack dead. Skip.

variants.title: Pokemon Lazarus
variants.hook: Complete Emerald hack by Emerald Seaglass's creator: an original Greece-inspired Ilios region and story, 400+ catchable Pokémon, all drawn in Seaglass's GBC-style graphics. v2.0 reworked the game from player feedback, adding new Megas and bug fixes. Traditional at heart.

variants.title: Pokemon - LeafGreen Version
variants.hook: FireRed's sibling.

variants.title: Pokemon Legends Delta (Beta)
variants.hook: FireRed/CFRU prequel set in an industrial-revolution Hoenn: play as ranger leader Nolan or Mr. Stone's son Orerick, probing a meteor that makes Pokémon aggressive. Megas, day/night and difficulty options; a short demo of roughly 1-2 hours. Just a taster.

variants.title: Pokemon Life (vA1.9)
variants.hook: Discontinued FireRed alpha set in the farm-born Nendios region: 250 handpicked Pokémon from all gens, B/W music and visuals, time-based events, side quests, IVs on the status screen. Blacking out ends the game, so save often. A curiosity.

variants.title: Pokemon Light and Shadow
variants.hook: Semi-open Emerald-expansion hack in the new Waikai region, played as Lance's daughter Rubi: hub-based progression, 100+ regional forms, legendary biome bosses instead of gyms, mandatory level caps, no IVs/EVs, and lasting status conditions removed.

variants.title: Pokemon Liquid Crystal
variants.hook: Crystal remade on FireRed: the original story with extra events, remastered Johto/Kanto maps, five-phase day/night and a new Orange Islands region. The last release is the 3.3.xxxxx Live Beta; the creator confirmed in 2023 it will never be finished. Historic, not essential.

variants.title: Pokemon Lithium
variants.hook: Sandbox Emerald-expansion hack: Hoenn plus Kanto, Johto and Sevii continents, every route, gym and event replayable for scaling rewards. Assign Pokémon one of six classes, ascend level-100s, tune difficulty modifiers, randomizer, an 18-badge campaign and a full economy. A systems toybox.

works.title: Pokemon Mega Mirage of Tales - A New Age Dawns

variants.title: Pokemon Mega Mirage of Tales - A New Age Dawns (v2.1u2)
matchNames: Pokemon Mega Mirage of Tales - A New Age Dawns (v2.1u2)
variants.hook: AvaraMoon's early FireRed beta: graduate from a trainer academy in Avlar, then choose a career such as trainer, researcher, ranger or criminal, each with its own missions and branches. The creator later disowned this build as unplanned and awful to play.

variants.title: Pokemon Monster Hunter
variants.hook: Probably TheNadei's Monster Hunter Emerald: Emerald's Hoenn story with every encounter swapped for 100+ Monster Hunter monsters with custom sprites, plus level caps, physical/special split and evolution stones. Battle Frontier and breeding are unsupported.

works.title: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Explorers of Darkness

variants.title: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Explorers of Darkness
matchNames: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Explorers of Darkness
variants.hook: Easy Mystery Dungeon with a strong story; Darkness version.

works.title: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Explorers of Fortune

variants.title: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Explorers of Fortune
matchNames: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Explorers of Fortune
variants.hook: Explorers of Sky expanded but kept vanilla in spirit: 250+ new Pokemon, 29 regional variants, Fairy type, Megas, new dungeons and side quests, a far bigger starter list, plus toggleable full team control, EXP share and move shortcuts.

works.title: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Explorers of Sky

variants.title: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Explorers of Sky
matchNames: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Explorers of Sky
variants.hook: Definitive Explorers version with extra episodes.

works.title: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Explorers of the Spirit

variants.title: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Explorers of the Spirit
matchNames: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Explorers of the Spirit
variants.hook: Full-length new PMD story on the Explorers of Sky engine (SkyTemple 2022 Hack of the Year): redesigned dungeons, a monotype dungeon per type, no traps or random monster houses, no item loss on failure. No manual-mode team control.

works.title: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Explorers of Time

variants.title: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Explorers of Time
matchNames: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Explorers of Time
variants.hook: Time version of Explorers.

works.title: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Red Rescue Team

variants.title: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Red Rescue Team
matchNames: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Red Rescue Team
variants.hook: Easy Mystery Dungeon with a sincere story.

works.title: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Rogue Rescue Team

variants.title: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Rogue Rescue Team
matchNames: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Rogue Rescue Team
variants.hook: Red Rescue Team rebuilt as a seeded roguelike: pick a seed, any hero/partner, and run a 10-dungeon gauntlet that reveals one challenge at a time. Normal/Hard/Nightmare shrink item carry and recruiting; cheese is nerfed. v3.0.0 includes NatDex mode. A must-try.

variants.title: Pokemon Nameless
variants.hook: Darker FireRed story across four regions as Chronya, a general's daughter: Gen 4-9 Pokémon, real Megas, Battle Arenas instead of gyms, a tournament instead of a League, skills replacing HMs, half-open world after Shedir Town, Normal or Dynamic difficulty.

variants.title: Pokemon Noon
variants.hook: iFunny-meme FireRed hack: stop censoring Team Grin across the new Efonni region with fakemon, pop-culture riffs and a trainer-CV fame system. The humor is deliberately crude and offensive, slurs included. Written about the Dec 2023 build. Skip.

variants.title: Pokemon Null
variants.hook: Hardcore Emerald-expansion hack built for veteran Nuzlocke players: mandatory level caps, reworked progression and encounters, double battles and Megas, Gen 9 dex, visible IVs/EVs and lots of QoL. Hard but designed to be fair. Good if you want a fight.

variants.title: Pokemon Odyssey
variants.hook: Pokémon x Etrian Odyssey on FireRed: dive the Yggdrasil Labyrinth as Nyx in a story-led dungeon crawl with double battles only, no gyms or League, rebalanced Gen 1-3 dex and Etrian variants, FOEs, gathering, naval exploration, and difficulty levels with soft caps. Strong pick.

variants.title: Pokemon Omega Paradox (Complete)
variants.hook: Story hack of Drayano's Volt White set after a Masked Man massacre: new gym leaders, E4 and rivals, 40+ new Pokemon incl. fakemon and Yu-Gi-Oh sprites, permanent Omega/Mega evolution by item. Starter choice sets difficulty.

variants.title: Pokemon Oops All Eevees
variants.hook: Kanto remix on FireRed/CFRU where every Pokémon is an Eevee: Eeveelutions in every type combination with their own stats and abilities, new trainer teams, expanded movesets, early Rare Candies, outfits, a tough postgame and plenty of jokes. A fun gimmick.

variants.title: Pokemon Origin HeartGold (English Patched)
variants.hook: Chinese hg-engine HeartGold overhaul retold with anime, Adventures manga and Origins characters: start in Kanto with Charmander, Pikachu or Bulbasaur, Johto after the Kanto title, quest-heavy, shared EXP. Crude mature humour; AI-assisted English patch.

variants.title: Pokemon Palimpsest
variants.hook: Escape-room battle puzzle on Emerald: your lone Pokémon can't level and has no moves, luck is rigged against you, and four prayer actions permanently steal a foe's species, item, ability or move. Exploit mechanics to pass the gods' exam. Clever and short.

variants.title: Pokemon Perfect Emerald
variants.hook: Kurrokin's presentation overhaul of Emerald: reworked graphics and battle weather, day/night with following Pokémon, DPPt/HGSS/BW music, split/STAB battle icons and many Heart & Soul ports. Creator lists real-hardware stutter and unfinished battle backgrounds.

variants.title: Pokemon Petalburg Dynasty
variants.hook: Gym-leader career sim on Emerald: as Champion you inherit Petalburg Gym, pick its type, defend against 24 generated challengers a season, climb or get relegated, manage injuries, staff, facilities, scouting and money. No overworld journey or badges. A systemic oddity worth a run.

variants.title: Pokemon Pinball - Ruby & Sapphire
variants.hook: Good pinball with catching.

variants.title: Pokemon Pisces
variants.hook: Pebbler Platoon's Emerald sequel: a remapped Hoenn with a new story, a 250+ dex mixing old and new Pokémon, plus many new moves, abilities and mechanics. The team pitches it as a deliberately tough ride.

variants.title: Pokemon - Platinum Version
variants.hook: Gen 4 definitive version.

variants.title: Pokemon Puzzle League
variants.hook: Panel de Pon with Pokemon skin; excellent chain puzzler.

variants.title: Pokemon R.O.W.E.
variants.hook: Open-world Hoenn plus Sevii: 16 gyms in any order with badge-based level scaling, every Pokémon (Gens 1-9) catchable from the start, Easy/Normal/Hard level caps, and modes like Randomized, Doubles, Inverse and Scalemon. Built for fast team-building.

variants.title: Pokemon Ranger
variants.hook: Stylus-circling capture game; thin.

variants.title: Pokemon Ranger - Shadows of Almia
variants.hook: More stylus circling.

variants.title: Pokemon Renegade Platinum
variants.hook: Drayano's Platinum overhaul: all 493 Pokemon obtainable, every trainer on boss AI, six-mon leaders with randomized E4/Champion teams, Fairy type and modern stats, revamped learnsets and TMs, buffs for weak mons, no trade evolutions.

variants.title: Pokemon Royal Sapphire
variants.hook: Hard Sapphire remake on strict Gen 3 mechanics: every map, trainer and learnset redone, Renegade Platinum-level bosses with no AI potions, a poison starter trio (Hisuian Sneasel/Qwilfish, Galarian Slowpoke), an expanded Team Aqua plot and full postgame. Cheap rare candies cut grinding.

variants.title: Pokemon Sacred Gold (v1.05 Complete)
variants.hook: Drayano's HeartGold overhaul: all 493 Pokemon obtainable (most before the E4), six-mon gym leaders and harder bosses, no trade evolutions, early EXP Share, fewer HM chores, E4 in any order, new events. 'Complete' includes his Pokemon stat/type edits.

variants.title: Pokemon Saiph (2020 Final)
variants.hook: Vytron's FireRed hack set in the new Colen region after Ranger: Shadows of Almia, against Team Void. Adds the Physical/Special split, Fairy type, later-gen Pokémon, day/night and a postgame slice of Hoenn. This is the 2020 bug-fix patch; the creator calls the game flawed.

variants.title: Pokemon Scorched Silver
variants.hook: Johto sequel set 20 years after Gold/Silver, with a new story against Team Phoenix over Celebi. Built on Emerald expansion: 750+ Pokémon, Physical/Special split, Fairy type, HM moves without HM slaves, postgame megas. Gym leaders use items and set-up, so it runs moderately hard.

variants.title: Pokemon Snakewood
variants.hook: Cutlerine's cult Ruby hack: three years on, zombies have overrun Hoenn and you hunt for your missing Champion brother. Expect 40-50 Fakemon, Denjuu, capturable zombie Pokémon, destroyed gyms, absurdist humour and slightly higher difficulty. Fast-forward can break scripts.

variants.title: Pokemon Sors
variants.hook: Vytron's FireRed story hack in the Hupest region: an Eclipse Tournament plot and an Eclipsing mechanic with 48 Solar/Lunar-form Pokémon, a near-full dex to Gen 7, Gen 7 mechanics, a quest log, day/night and Soaring. On mGBA, apply the creator's Emulator Fix patch.

variants.title: Pokemon SoulGold
variants.hook: rahtak's Johto-only HnS-expansion port: expanded Johto with new tiles, 9 starters, type-generic Mega Stones, hidden grottos, multi-bar legendary bosses, 100+ achievements, battle facilities and postgame multi-ability 'innates'. Optional level caps and plenty of options.

variants.title: Pokemon - SoulSilver Version
variants.hook: HeartGold's sibling.

variants.title: Pokemon Storm Silver (v1.05 Complete)
variants.hook: SoulSilver twin of Sacred Gold: Drayano's 493-Pokemon Johto/Kanto with six-mon leaders, tougher bosses, trade-free evolutions, early EXP Share and new events. Minor wild-encounter differences only; you need just one of the pair.

variants.title: Pokemon Sunset
variants.hook: hyperbeam's 'vanilla++' LeafGreen hack: same Kanto adventure with stylized new graphics, new Sunset Forms, more Ghost and Dark types, plus move/stat tweaks and light QoL like running shoes. Harder than vanilla but explicitly not a challenge hack.

variants.title: Pokemon Super Mystery Dungeon
variants.hook: The hardest and most systemic PMD; recruit 720 Pokemon via a connection map.

variants.title: Pokemon Synthesis
variants.hook: Lethesis's semi-open-world demo in the new Veldan region: quests in any order build local reputation until the gym leader will face you; Gens 1-9 with modern mechanics and optional dungeons. v0.1.1 holds only the first of four areas (5-8 hrs, ends at gym 1).

variants.title: Pokemon The Pit
variants.hook: Roguelite gauntlet modelled on Paper Mario's Pit of 100 Trials: random starters, 1-4 random trainers per floor scaling to Lv100, shop/heal/tutor every 5 floors, a boss plus recruit every 25, endless past 100. Singles/doubles/mixed plus heavy randomizer and difficulty options.

variants.title: Pokemon The Unown King
variants.hook: Clessidra's short TARC 2 puzzle hack: explore the Temple of the Unown King collecting 26 Unown, each unlocking a letter so you can read wall inscriptions. Find 8 HMs (usable without teaching) and beat single-Pokémon bosses with thick health bars. Gen 5-style overworld, FFVIII-remix soundtrack.

variants.title: Pokemon TRE Johto
variants.hook: Dragonsden's Team Rocket Edition: rise from grunt to Admin across the FRLG-to-GSC timeline, with the English 2025-04-30 release covering Kanto, Sevii and Johto (~70 hrs). Adds Rocket rank progression, Rocket-experiment Pokémon, Physical/Special split, no trade evolutions. Not Colonelsalt's FR Rocket Edition.

variants.title: Pokemon Ultra Shiny Gold Sigma
variants.hook: Alex Sanchez's Gold remake on FireRed, sprawling across Johto, Kanto, Orange-Alola Islands and Hoenn with Gens 1-9, regional forms, Megas, no trade evolutions, a 5-phase clock, wonder-trade sim and level cap 255. v1.5.1 is a big bug-fix pass; some areas are still marked not yet available.

variants.title: Pokemon Ultra Violet
variants.hook: LocksmithArmy's FireRed hack built so one save can catch all 386: FireRed and LeafGreen encounters merged, both fossils and fighting gifts, no trade evolutions, event legendaries via shop tickets, and a new 4-Points Isle holding Gen 3. Otherwise vanilla FireRed.

variants.title: Pokemon Unbound
variants.hook: Skeli's CFRU flagship in the Borrius region: Gen 1-7 Pokémon with a near-Gen 8 battle engine, four difficulty modes up to Insane with new AI, 80+ tracked missions, DexNav, raids, HM-free field moves and 180+ original tracks. v2.1.1.1 is a bug fix of the 2.1.1 rebalance and dialogue trims.

variants.title: Pokemon Valiant
variants.hook: Shachar700's Emerald story hack in LAVAN, a Levant-inspired region: Team Smash chases the time-travelling Celebi, with Gen 1-3 Pokémon plus cross-gen evolutions, Physical/Special split and Fairy type. Beta: ends at Lilycove harbour after the LAVAN League; the Hoenn half isn't out.

variants.title: Pokemon Vega Fairy Edition EX
variants.hook: Edit of Dr. Akimbo's English 'Vega Minus' build of the translated fakemon hack Vega (Tohoak region): adds the Fairy type and moves, Deneb/Procyon Pokémon and sprites, overhauled trainer sprites, a new legendary, and Fairy leader Gwendolyn in place of Annette. v1.4 is the final balance patch.

variants.title: Pokemon Vintage White Plus
variants.hook: White remade with only Gen 1-3 Pokemon: harder trainers, type/stat changes, overhauled learnsets, new Eeveelutions, no trade evolutions, Gold/Silver music. v1.5 is an early Plus build; the creator has since updated it well beyond this.

variants.title: Pokemon Volt White 2 (Complete)
variants.hook: Drayano's White 2 overhaul: all 649 Pokemon catchable in-game, rebuilt trainer rosters for a much harder curve, 8+ species per area, plus Pokemon/move/learnset edits in this Complete patch. Superseded by Redux.

variants.title: Pokemon Volt White 2 Redux Complete
variants.hook: AphexCubed and Drayano's remake of Volt White 2: 649 catchable, Fairy type, modern stats and learnsets, expanded difficulty modes, revamped legendaries, ~2-3 hr Unity Tower postgame, EV/level trainers, shiny 1/512. Fairy code favours emulators.

variants.title: Pokemon Wild Indigo
